correctness.rationale: The exact neighbor count for absent edge ab is deg_H(a)+deg_H(b); the only forbidden degree pair is (0,1). Minimal edge covers are precisely spanning star forests, whereas any fort with an isolated original vertex has no degree-one vertex and contains a cycle. Minimality then reduces it to a single proper cycle. The converse checks every nonempty proper subset, not merely single deletions. Independent cardinality calculations from the exponential construction match direct subset-mask enumeration through n=7 and a component recurrence through n=20. Finite tests are corroborative, not the proof.

value.rationale: All inclusion-minimal forts of a standard infinite line/Johnson graph family constitute its exact fort-cover hypergraph, a natural combinatorial object relevant to zero forcing. The two-type structural theorem and complete weighted EGF distinguish nonminimum forts and yield exact multiplicities in every cardinality. This is a substantive classification rather than a toy numerical extension or recomputation of the scalar failed zero forcing number.
